verdict.rationale: Mesh documents ongoing monitoring as a first-party capability. Per-customer monitor status and configuration endpoints exist, with a 'Monitor and unmonitor customers' permission. Case management prioritises risk alerts raised during ongoing monitoring, and those alerts can be decided in the web app or via the API. A webhook system exists, though the only documented event type (WORKFLOW_COMPLETED) is tied to screening workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that re-screening is triggered by watchlist/data updates, a documented webhook event type specific to monitoring-generated alerts or changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
